question: What is DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) valuation?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-D with mid-career experience
description: Technical interview question for Track-D professionals.
exampleAnswer: DCF values a company based on projected future cash flows discounted to present value. Steps: 1) Project free cash flows, 2) Calculate terminal value, 3) Discount at WACC. In my project, I valued a SaaS company at INR 50 crores using DCF, which was close to the market price of INR 48 crores.
